http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/location-physical-type  bdBedA space that is allocated for sleeping/laying on. This is not the physical bed/trolley that may be moved about, but the space it may occupy.
http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/location-physical-type  roRoomA space that is allocated as a room, it may have walls/roof etc., but does not require these.
http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/location-physical-type  waWardA Ward is a section of a medical facility that may contain rooms and other types of location.
